en.headline: CK Asset denies rumour of Li Ka-shing's death as utterly without foundation
en.dek: The company condemned mainland self-media accounts that falsely claimed Ta Kung Pao had reported the 98-year-old tycoon's death, and urged verification before sharing.
body: CK Asset Holdings on Thursday issued a statement denying rumours circulating on mainland social media that 98-year-old Li Ka-shing had died.

The company said there was absolutely no truth to the claim and strongly condemned self-media accounts for fabricating fake news. It noted that some accounts had falsely attributed a report of Li's death to Hong Kong's Ta Kung Pao newspaper.

CK Asset expressed disappointment that some media outlets had republished the false information without verification, and called on organisations and the public to confirm accuracy before reporting or sharing such content.

Li, founder of the Cheung Kong and Hutchison groups and now senior advisor to the companies, has rarely appeared in public since stepping back from day-to-day leadership. His most recent widely circulated photograph was released in May by the Li Ka Shing Foundation.
The company said the rumours were without any basis.

zh.headline: 長實否認李嘉誠逝世傳聞 指絕無其事並譴責捏造假新聞
zh.dek: 公司指內地自媒體訛稱大公報報道98歲李嘉誠逝世，實屬捏造，呼籲報道或轉載前務必核實。
body: 長江實業集團周四發表聲明，否認內地社交媒體流傳的98歲李嘉誠逝世傳聞。
長實表示「絕無其事」，並強烈譴責有關自媒體嘩眾取寵、別有用心捏造假新聞。聲明指出，部分帳號訛稱香港大公報曾報道李嘉誠逝世。
公司對媒體未經證實即轉載假新聞表示失望，並呼籲各界在作出新聞報道或轉載前，務必確認內容真確性。
李嘉誠為長和系創辦人，現為集團資深顧問，自退出日常管理後甚少公開露面。最近一次廣泛流傳的照片由李嘉誠基金會於五月發布。
長實強調有關傳聞毫無根據。
